name: Yoga Funcional Panamá

display.use: Uppercase H1, major H2 and oversized statements only; never artificially condense.

utility.use: Numbers, locations, schedules, section labels and technical information.

accent.use: One expressive word, principally Yoga; never UI or prose.

spacing.principle: Fluid, viewport-aware spacing; tight inside utility structures and expansive between editorial ideas.

layout: Display type may break the grid
Desktop is recomposed, not simply enlarged
photography: Use only consented real practice photography
Prioritize effort, balance, mobility, strength and recovery
Use large or unusual crops with body/type overlap
Use visibly labelled graphic placeholders until real assets exist
motion: Motion reinforces type hierarchy and physicality
responsive: Dominant type remains dominant on small screens
Collapse navigation without hiding the primary action
forbidden: Lotus, mandala, chakra or spiritual symbols
